parameters.name: DestinationMACAddress
parameters.description: MAC address of the destination node of the link being measured.

parameters.name: SNR
parameters.description: The result of an SNR test performed over the channel. It is formatted as a comma-separated list of N/M unsigned integers that represents the result of Signal-to-Noise-Ratio measurement (in {{units}}) averaging in groups of M subcarriers. The number N depends on the bandplan used by the node and corresponds to the OFDM control parameter N of each medium as defined in {{bibref|G.9964}}. The number M corresponds to the parameter {{param|##.SNRGroupLength}}.

object.description: Per-channel G.hn performance monitoring results during the current sample interval. Each table entry contains the results collected from the channel between a G.hn interface (as indicated by {{param|##.DiagnoseMACAddress}}) and a G.hn interface indicated by {{param|DestinationMACAddress}})
